title: Исход 23 — Exodus 23
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: Do not follow the crowd in doing evil.
cases.explain: The preposition за (after/behind) with следовать takes the instrumental → большинством.

cases.translation: …your enemy's ox or donkey has gone astray.
cases.explain: Possession ("of your enemy") is expressed by the genitive → врага.

cases.translation: …if you see that the donkey has fallen under its load.
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) with a location takes the instrumental → ношей.

cases.translation: …because you yourselves were them in Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" a place (location, no motion) takes the prepositional → Египте.

cases.sentence: Пусть никто не приходит поклоняться мне с пустыми ___.
cases.translation: Let no one come to worship me empty-handed.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → руками (instrumental plural).

cases.sentence: Мой ангел пойдёт перед вами и приведёт вас в ___ Амареев.
cases.translation: My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites.
cases.explain: The preposition в marking motion into a place takes the accusative → землю.
The verb служить (to serve) governs the dative → Господу.

cases.translation: I will deliver you from sicknesses.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) takes the genitive → болезней (genitive plural).

reading.ru: Три раза в год устраивай мне праздник.
reading.question: How often were the Israelites to hold a feast to God?
reading.explain: The text commands, 'Three times a year hold a feast to me.'

reading.ru: Не бери взятки, потому что взятка ослепляет зрячих и губит невиновных.
reading.question: Why are the people told not to take a bribe?
options: Because a bribe blinds those who see and ruins the innocent
Because judges do not accept them
Because they belong to the priests
reading.correct: Because a bribe blinds those who see and ruins the innocent
reading.explain: The verse says a bribe blinds the sighted and destroys the innocent.

reading.ru: Шесть лет засевай поля и собирай урожай, а на седьмой год пусть земля отдыхает под паром.
reading.question: What was to happen to the land in the seventh year?
options: It should rest and lie fallow
reading.correct: It should rest and lie fallow
reading.explain: After six years of sowing, the seventh year the land was to rest and lie fallow.

reading.ru: Я посылаю перед вами ангела, чтобы защищать вас в пути и привести на место, которое я приготовил.
reading.question: Why does God say he is sending an angel ahead of the people?
options: To guard them on the way and bring them to the prepared place
To teach them a new language
reading.correct: To guard them on the way and bring them to the prepared place
reading.explain: The angel is sent to protect them on the journey and bring them to the place God prepared.

reading.ru: Не поклоняйтесь их богам, не служите им, и не подражайте их обычаям.
reading.question: What are the people told regarding the gods of the nations?
options: Do not worship them, serve them, or imitate their customs
reading.correct: Do not worship them, serve them, or imitate their customs
reading.explain: The command forbids worshiping, serving, or imitating the practices of those gods.

reading.ru: Не вари козленка в молоке его матери.
reading.question: What cooking prohibition is given at the end of the passage?
options: Do not boil a young goat in its mother's milk
Do not eat bread with leaven
Do not roast meat on the Sabbath
Do not drink wine before offerings
reading.correct: Do not boil a young goat in its mother's milk
reading.explain: The text specifically forbids boiling a young goat in its mother's milk.
